colocationBooking.title: Reserve configuration
colocationBooking.commentPlaceholder: Describe the equipment or connection details
colocationBooking.instructionIntro: Enter the combined parameters of all equipment:

instructions.units: Rack units — add up the height of all devices in U.
instructions.power: Power supplies — enter the total capacity across all devices; if a device has two power supplies, count only one.
instructions.ip: IP addresses — select the required number of public IPv4 addresses.
instructions.speed: Internet speed — select the required speed and channel type.
instructions.comment: Comment — specify equipment models, the connection scheme, and additional requirements.

colocationBooking.instructionResult: The calculator shows the estimated monthly cost and one-time installation fee. A manager will confirm the final configuration.
colocationBooking.success: Thank you! Your configuration was sent to our manager. We will contact you shortly.
colocationBooking.error: Could not send your request. Please try again.

consultationModal.successMessage: Thank you! We'll get back to you shortly.
